spot.html_text: Psychology is the science of behavior. Psychology is not the science of the inner mind – as something other or different from behavior. Behavior can be described and explained without making ultimate reference to mental events or to internal psychological processes. The sources of behavior are external (in the environment), not internal (in the mind, in the head).
